hook_title: Your next subscriber hit is already hiding in the data.
hook_sub: Cultural Lens reads stories, audiences and influence before you commission.

pains.title: Greenlighting on gut feel
pains.detail: Regional originals are expensive, and most decisions still rest on past ratings rather than story-level evidence.

pains.title: Viewers leave between seasons
pains.detail: Subscribers join for one title and drift away when the next hook arrives too late.

pains.title: Great stories, unseen
pains.detail: Without moments built for short-form, titles struggle to travel beyond their home market.

solutions.title: Score scripts before you shoot
solutions.detail: Read pacing, stakes and emotional beats against regional and global hits.

solutions.title: See what keeps viewers watching
solutions.detail: Map the scenes, characters and promises that hold an audience episode after episode.

solutions.title: Design moments that travel
solutions.detail: Find and plan the clips that carry a title across markets on social.

vo.hook: O T T platforms: your next subscriber hit may already be hiding in the data. Cultural Lens reads stories, audiences and influence, before you commission.
vo.pains: For streaming platforms, three costs keep growing. Greenlighting expensive originals on gut feel. Viewers who leave between seasons. And great stories that never travel beyond home.
vo.solutions: Cultural Lens answers each one. Story intelligence scores scripts before you shoot. Audience intelligence shows what keeps viewers watching. And viral intelligence designs the moments that travel.
